# Entity model with search-optimized fields, history, and version tracking

Entities are stored with search-optimized names, additional payload, completeness anchors, and records of first/last compile runs, supporting querying, history tracking, and full-text search. Unique and indexed fields facilitate fast lookups and relationship building.
